description: Return how to connect to a specific instance (by id or exact name): its IP, hostname, port block, and every port mapping with the public port players use. Ports refresh from the server on every call, so this is more current than get_instance_info. Also reports whether SFTP is enabled and, when `confirm` is true, its credentials. The password is only returned when the user has explicitly asked to see it.

confirm.description: Set true to include the SFTP password in plaintext. Only do this when the user explicitly asked to see it.

include_detected.description: Also scan the running server for listening ports that are not mapped yet. Only works while the server is running.

instance.description: Instance id (preferred) or exact instance name.

name: get_connection_info
title: Get Connection Info
